svg.aria-label: Flow Field — a year of contributions drawn as a field of streamlines
svg.title: Flow Field
svg.desc: Every stroke follows the same continuous vector field, so neighbours stay parallel; only the density varies, and it varies with how much was committed that week.
svg.text: FRONTEND ENGINEER · A YEAR, AS A VECTOR FIELD
SEEDED · DETERMINISTIC · REGENERATE FOR A DIFFERENT YEAR
